name: Özata Denizcilik Sanayi ve Ticareti AS
summary: Özata Denizcilik Sanayi ve Ticareti AS specializes in providing comprehensive marine vessel repair services. The company's expertise encompasses the maintenance, construction, and restoration of a diverse range of watercraft, such as luxury yachts, passenger ships, fishing trawlers, search and rescue (SAR) boats, and advanced carbon fiber catamaran ferries. Established in 1985 by Ozdemir Ataseven, its central operations are based in Altinova, Turkey.
